blurb: Sticky navbar with scroll-triggered blur background and responsive mobile menu.
description: Multi-component navbar system (Navbar, NavBody, NavItems, MobileNav) with scroll detection via Framer Motion. Adds glass-morphism blur effect at scroll threshold and toggles mobile menu visibility using ResizeObserver.
use_when: Creating a responsive header that needs to visually respond to scroll state, especially for landing pages or marketing…
avoid_when: Fixed-position navbars that must be visible at all times without visual changes. High-traffic navigation where scroll…
a11y: Mobile nav button lacks proper ARIA attributes. Keyboard navigation not fully supported. Focus management not built-in.
